items.title: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
items.summary: Opponents have questioned the Budget's lack of detail on welfare reform, with the prime minister not outlining a timetable for any reductions.

items.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over handling of letter about Meghan's father
items.summary: The Metropolitan Police has referred itself to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) over a letter containing allegations about the Duchess of Sussex's father Thomas Markle Sr.

items.title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
items.summary: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

items.title: Poundland closer to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
items.summary: Poundland has filed notice to appoint administrators, bringing it one step closer to collapse.

items.title: Jury shown CCTV of train staff using frying pan in defence
items.summary: Witnesses say Samir Zitouni is a 'real-life hero' who told attacker "We love you, we can help you".

items.title: Why defeated Flavio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for Miami - and what comes next
items.summary: On Wednesday, Flavio Bolsonaro, who last week lost Brazil's presidential election, was seen arriving in the US on a private jet after having fled in the dead of night.
